title: How Amazon is expanding its car-sales business
title_zh: 亚马逊如何拓展汽车销售业务
summary: Amazon (AMZN) is expanding its car-sales business to include Jeep, Chevrolet, and other automakers. Yahoo Finance Senior Autos Reporter Pras Subramanian breaks down the details.

title: Amazon stock is leading the 'Magnificent 7' rebound — but the rally is hitting a ceiling: Chart of the Day
title_zh: 亚马逊股票引领“华丽七”反弹，但反弹已触及上限：每日图表
summary: Amazon stock has been one of the strongest names in the "Magnificent Seven" since the broader market's March 30 low. But after a sharp three-day surge, its rally is now running into an area that has repeatedly stopped it before.
summary_zh: 自大盘 3 月 30 日触及低点以来​​，亚马逊股票一直是“七巨头”中表现最强劲的股票之一。但在经历了三天的大幅上涨之后，其涨势现在正在进入之前曾多次阻止的区域。

title: 'Timing really does matter': Why markets need US-Iran conflict to wrap up soon
title_zh: “时机确实很重要”：为什么市场需要美伊冲突尽快结束
summary: US stocks (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) are mixed at Monday's market open following President Trump's latest order to blockade the Strait of Hormuz starting as early as today. This comes after failed ceasefire talks between US officials and Iran over this past weekend.
summary_zh: 在特朗普总统最早从今天开始封锁霍尔木兹海峡的最新命令之后，美国股市（^DJI、^IXIC、^GSPC）周一开盘涨跌互现。此前，美国官员与伊朗上周末的停火谈判失败。
